words.enDefinition: the day someone is due to leave or leaves hospital

examples.en: The ward clerk asked me to confirm the discharge date with my roommate.
examples.zh: 病区办事员请我和室友确认一下「出院日期」。

examples.en: I wrote the discharge date in my calendar beside the start of term.
examples.zh: 我在日历的开学日期旁边记下了「出院日期」。

words.enDefinition: an outline of departure and ongoing support after hospital care

examples.en: The discharge plan listed who would contact me when I got home.
examples.zh: 「出院计划」里列出了我回家后谁会联系我。

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the discharge plan to share with my family.
examples.zh: 我要了一份「出院计划」的副本和家人分享。

words.enDefinition: a staff member who helps arrange a patient's departure and support

examples.en: The discharge coordinator called me back after I had checked my ride home.
examples.zh: 我确认了回家的车之后，「出院协调员」给我回了电话。

examples.en: I wrote down the discharge coordinator's number in case I had another question.
examples.zh: 我记下了「出院协调员」的电话号码，以防还有问题。

words.enDefinition: an area for patients waiting to finish leaving hospital

examples.en: My brother found the discharge lounge after asking at the main reception desk.
examples.zh: 我哥哥到总服务台问了路，找到了「出院等候区」。

examples.en: I waited in the discharge lounge until my flatmate arrived to meet me.
examples.zh: 我在「出院等候区」等到室友来接我。

collocations: a seat in the discharge lounge

words.enDefinition: a list of items to check before leaving hospital

examples.en: The nurse went through the discharge checklist while I packed my belongings.
examples.zh: 我收拾个人物品时，护士过了一遍「出院核对清单」。

examples.en: The discharge checklist had a space for the phone number of my local clinic.
examples.zh: 「出院核对清单」上留了位置填本地诊所的电话号码。

words.enDefinition: the transition from hospital care back to one's own home

examples.en: The ward team discussed discharge home after finding out who could meet me there.
examples.zh: 弄清楚谁可以在家等我之后，病区团队讨论了「出院回家」的安排。

examples.en: I asked whether discharge home was still the plan for Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问星期五下午是否仍按计划「出院回家」。

words.enDefinition: leaving hospital despite the care team's recommendation to stay

examples.en: The interpreter explained the term discharge against medical advice on the hospital form.
examples.zh: 口译员解释了医院表格里「违背医嘱出院」这个词。

examples.en: I asked the nurse what discharge against medical advice meant in the translated leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问护士，翻译后的宣传单里「违背医嘱出院」是什么意思。

collocations: a record of discharge against medical advice
a form for discharge against medical advice

words.enDefinition: judged by the care team to no longer need inpatient-level medical care

examples.en: The doctor said I was medically ready for discharge, but my ride was late.
examples.zh: 医生说我已经「达到医学出院条件」，但接我的车还没来。

examples.en: I asked the interpreter what the phrase medically ready for discharge meant.
examples.zh: 我请口译员解释「达到医学出院条件」是什么意思。

collocations: be assessed as medically ready for discharge
record when someone is medically ready for discharge

words.enDefinition: leaving hospital with organized support available after departure

examples.en: The ward team described a supported discharge while we discussed going home.
examples.zh: 我们商量回家的安排时，病区团队介绍了「有后续支持的出院」。

examples.en: I asked whether supported discharge included a contact for questions over the weekend.
examples.zh: 我问选择「有后续支持的出院」后，周末有问题能否联系相关人员。

words.enDefinition: a later check on someone after they leave hospital

examples.en: The ward sent a message to confirm the date of my post-discharge follow-up.
examples.zh: 病区发来消息，确认我的「出院后随访」日期。

examples.en: I asked if the post-discharge follow-up would be by phone or in person.
examples.zh: 我问「出院后随访」是通过电话还是当面进行。

words.enDefinition: care or practical support arranged after a hospital stay

examples.en: Before leaving, I asked who would organize my post-discharge care at home.
examples.zh: 离院前，我问谁会安排我在家的「出院后照护」。

examples.en: The hospital sent details of my post-discharge care to the community team.
examples.zh: 医院把我的「出院后照护」细节发给了社区团队。

words.enDefinition: a care or support appointment held at a person's home

examples.en: The community nurse asked whether Tuesday morning would suit me for a home visit.
examples.zh: 社区护士问我星期二上午是否方便「上门访视」。

examples.en: I showed my flatmate the message that confirmed my home visit next week.
examples.zh: 我把确认下周「上门访视」的消息给室友看了。

words.enDefinition: an admission to hospital after a previous hospital stay

examples.en: The form asked whether there had been a hospital readmission since my last review.
examples.zh: 表格询问我上次复查之后是否曾「再次入院」。

examples.en: I asked which dates to list for the hospital readmission on my university form.
examples.zh: 我问学校表格上该填写「再次入院」的哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: arranged transport for patients who do not need an emergency response

examples.en: I asked the ward desk who to contact about non-emergency patient transport.
examples.zh: 我问病区服务台，要咨询「非紧急医疗接送」该联系谁。

examples.en: The leaflet gave a phone number for questions about non-emergency patient transport.
examples.zh: 宣传单上给了一个电话，可以咨询「非紧急医疗接送」的相关问题。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement reserving a journey for a particular time

examples.en: The ward clerk checked the transport booking before telling me the pickup time.
examples.zh: 病区办事员查询了「接送预约」，才告诉我接人的时间。

examples.en: I asked whether my transport booking showed the new address near campus.
examples.zh: 我问我的「接送预约」有没有写上学校附近的新地址。

collocations: a reference for a transport booking

words.enDefinition: a professional who helps hospital patients access practical and social support

examples.en: The hospital social worker helped me find the contact details for my local service.
examples.zh: 「医院社工」帮我找到了本地服务机构的联系方式。

examples.en: I asked the hospital social worker about support after I returned to student housing.
examples.zh: 我向「医院社工」咨询了回到学生公寓后能获得的支持。

collocations: speak to a hospital social worker
a referral to a hospital social worker

words.enDefinition: a discussion about a patient's departure and plans for later support

examples.en: I asked if my sister could join the discharge meeting by phone.
examples.zh: 我问姐姐能否通过电话参加「出院安排会议」。

examples.en: The ward team gave me time to ask questions during the discharge meeting.
examples.zh: 病区团队在「出院安排会议」中留出时间让我提问。

collocations: take notes at a discharge meeting

words.enDefinition: a review to establish what practical or personal support someone needs

examples.en: I described how far I lived from campus during the care needs assessment.
examples.zh: 在「照护需求评估」中，我说明了自己的住处离学校有多远。

examples.en: The social worker asked if my family could join the care needs assessment.
examples.zh: 社工问我的家人能不能参加「照护需求评估」。

collocations: the outcome of a care needs assessment

words.enDefinition: a review of the home environment for access and potential hazards

examples.en: The therapist took notes about the entrance during the home safety assessment.
examples.zh: 「居家安全评估」时，治疗师记录了入口的情况。

examples.en: I checked that the home safety assessment would cover our shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 我确认了「居家安全评估」会包括我们共用的卫生间。

collocations: carry out a home safety assessment
a report from a home safety assessment

words.enDefinition: short-term support between hospital care and more independent living

examples.en: The discharge team mentioned intermediate care while we discussed support at home.
examples.zh: 我们讨论居家支持时，出院团队提到了「过渡照护」。

examples.en: I asked who would coordinate my intermediate care once I left the hospital.
examples.zh: 我问出院后谁会协调我的「过渡照护」。

words.enDefinition: plans for who provides care and when it happens

examples.en: I called my mother once the ward had confirmed the care arrangements.
examples.zh: 病区确认「照护安排」后，我给妈妈打了电话。

examples.en: The social worker wrote down our care arrangements before meeting my flatmate.
examples.zh: 社工和室友见面前，先记下了我们的「照护安排」。

words.enDefinition: the time spent regaining health or function after a setback

examples.en: I stayed with my cousin for the first part of my recovery period.
examples.zh: 「恢复期」的前一段，我住在表姐家。

examples.en: My tutor asked what dates I expected to be away during the recovery period.
examples.zh: 导师问，在「恢复期」里，我估计哪几天会缺课。

words.enDefinition: to rest and regain strength after illness or injury

examples.en: I went home to recuperate and asked my tutor to send the seminar notes.
examples.zh: 我回家「休养」，请导师把研讨课的笔记发给我。

examples.en: My roommate stayed with family to recuperate before returning to our shared flat.
examples.zh: 室友先和家人住在一起「休养恢复」，之后才回合租公寓。

words.enDefinition: regaining health or ability slowly over a period of time

examples.en: I told my tutor about the gradual recovery and our revised return date.
examples.zh: 我把「逐步恢复」的情况和调整后的返校日期告诉了导师。

examples.en: The report described a gradual recovery since I had left the hospital.
examples.zh: 报告描述了我离开医院后「逐步恢复」的情况。

words.enDefinition: the return to a person's previous state of health or function

examples.en: I asked what full recovery meant for the activities I normally did.
examples.zh: 我问，以我平时做的那些活动来说，「完全康复」意味着什么。

examples.en: The therapist explained that returning to class was separate from a full recovery.
examples.zh: 治疗师解释，回去上课和「完全康复」是两回事。

collocations: the timing of a full recovery

words.enDefinition: a noticeable step or achievement during someone's recovery

examples.en: Getting back to the library for the first time felt like a recovery milestone.
examples.zh: 能够在康复后第一天回到图书馆，对我来说是一个「康复阶段性成果」。

examples.en: The therapist asked which recovery milestone was most important to me that month.
examples.zh: 治疗师问我，那个月哪个「康复阶段性成果」对我最重要。

words.enDefinition: the return of abilities used for movement or daily tasks

examples.en: The report described functional recovery in terms of the tasks I could do again.
examples.zh: 报告用我重新能做哪些事来说明「功能恢复」的情况。

examples.en: I asked the therapist how my functional recovery would be recorded over time.
examples.zh: 我问治疗师，之后会如何记录我的「功能恢复」。

words.enDefinition: become able to manage everyday life without the same help

examples.en: The team asked what would help me regain independence in my shared flat.
examples.zh: 团队问，在我合租的公寓里，什么能帮助我「恢复独立生活的能力」。

examples.en: I wanted to regain independence before I moved back into my student accommodation.
examples.zh: 我想先「恢复独立生活的能力」，再搬回学生公寓。

words.enDefinition: become able to move around again after losing some ability

examples.en: The therapist asked what I wanted to do first as I began to regain mobility.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，开始「恢复活动能力」后，我最想先做什么。

examples.en: I wrote down what would make it easier to regain mobility around campus.
examples.zh: 我记下了什么能让我更容易「恢复在学校里活动的能力」。

words.enDefinition: a record of changes and personal experiences during recovery

examples.en: I brought my recovery diary so the therapist could see what had changed.
examples.zh: 我带来了「康复日记」，好让治疗师了解有哪些变化。

examples.en: My recovery diary kept track of the first time I managed different tasks again.
examples.zh: 我的「康复日记」记下了我第一次重新做成各项活动的时间。

words.enDefinition: organized support for restoring or adapting abilities after illness or injury

examples.en: The ward team explained which local services offered rehabilitation after a hospital stay.
examples.zh: 病区团队说明了哪些本地机构提供出院后的「康复服务」。

examples.en: I asked whether rehabilitation would take place at the same hospital or elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我问「康复服务」是在同一家医院进行，还是在别的地方进行。

words.enDefinition: a coordinated set of services and goals to support recovery

examples.en: The clinician sent me a written explanation of the rehabilitation program before I enrolled.
examples.zh: 我接受服务前，医务人员给我发了一份「康复方案」说明。

examples.en: I checked whether the rehabilitation program included any appointments near my student housing.
examples.zh: 我问了「康复方案」里会不会安排离学生公寓近的就诊。

words.enDefinition: a place providing organized care to help people regain function

examples.en: The social worker showed me where the rehabilitation facility was on the map.
examples.zh: 社工在地图上给我指出了「康复机构」的位置。

examples.en: I asked the rehabilitation facility which entrance our visitors should use on weekends.
examples.zh: 我问「康复机构」，周末探访的人应该走哪个入口。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation received while staying overnight in a care facility

examples.en: The team explained inpatient rehabilitation when we discussed where I would stay next.
examples.zh: 我们讨论下一步去哪儿住时，团队介绍了「住院康复」。

examples.en: I asked whether the leaflet about inpatient rehabilitation listed visiting hours for families.
examples.zh: 我问有关「住院康复」的小册子有没有写家属探视时间。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation received at visits without an overnight stay

examples.en: I asked whether outpatient rehabilitation could be arranged around my university timetable.
examples.zh: 我问「门诊康复」可不可以配合我的大学课表来安排。

examples.en: The letter gave the address for outpatient rehabilitation and a number for questions.
examples.zh: 信里写了「门诊康复」的地点和咨询电话。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation provided by local services outside a hospital stay

examples.en: I got a call from the community rehabilitation team on my first day home.
examples.zh: 我回家第一天，就接到了「社区康复」团队的电话。

examples.en: The nurse explained how community rehabilitation differed from appointments at the hospital.
examples.zh: 护士说明了「社区康复」与去医院就诊有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: rehabilitation care or support provided in the person's home

examples.en: I asked what would be included in home-based rehabilitation after leaving hospital.
examples.zh: 我问出院后的「居家康复」会包括哪些服务。

examples.en: The letter explained who would contact me about my home-based rehabilitation appointments.
examples.zh: 信里说明了谁会联系我安排「居家康复」上门时间。

words.enDefinition: a group of professionals working together to support someone's recovery

examples.en: The rehabilitation team introduced its members before asking about my plans for the term.
examples.zh: 「康复团队」的成员先作了自我介绍，然后问了我这学期的计划。

examples.en: I copied the rehabilitation team into the email about my change of address.
examples.zh: 我发邮件告知地址变更时，抄送了「康复团队」。

collocations: a member of the rehabilitation team

words.enDefinition: specific outcomes someone wants to work toward during rehabilitation

examples.en: I talked about getting back to my lab classes when setting rehabilitation goals.
examples.zh: 制定「康复目标」时，我提到了希望能回去上实验课。

examples.en: The therapist asked which rehabilitation goals mattered most for my everyday routine.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，哪些「康复目标」对我的日常生活最重要。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of abilities and support needs for rehabilitation

examples.en: The therapist asked about my weekday routine during the rehabilitation assessment on Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五做「康复评估」时，治疗师问了我平时工作日的作息。

examples.en: I asked which building would be used for the rehabilitation assessment next week.
examples.zh: 我问下周的「康复评估」要在哪栋楼做。

collocations: a report from a rehabilitation assessment

words.enDefinition: changes in ability or participation as someone goes through rehabilitation

examples.en: The therapist used my own notes when reviewing rehabilitation progress with me.
examples.zh: 治疗师和我一起回顾「康复进展」时，参考了我自己记的笔记。

examples.en: I asked who would be able to read the report on my rehabilitation progress.
examples.zh: 我问哪些人能看我的「康复进展」报告。

words.enDefinition: care focused on improving movement and physical ability

examples.en: My student clinic gave me the contact number for the physical therapy department.
examples.zh: 校医院给了我「物理治疗」科室的联系电话。

examples.en: I asked whether physical therapy appointments were available after my morning lab.
examples.zh: 我问上午实验课结束后，有没有可以预约的「物理治疗」时段。

words.enDefinition: a professional who helps people improve movement and physical function

examples.en: The physical therapist asked what activities were most important to me on campus.
examples.zh: 「物理治疗师」问，在学校的活动中哪些对我最重要。

examples.en: I called the physical therapist to confirm the location in the appointment letter.
examples.zh: 我给「物理治疗师」打了电话，确认预约信上写的地点。

collocations: a referral to a physical therapist

words.enDefinition: care focused on making meaningful everyday activities easier to carry out

examples.en: The occupational therapy leaflet included examples of work, study, and household tasks.
examples.zh: 「作业治疗」的宣传单列举了工作、学习和家务方面的活动。

examples.en: I asked whether occupational therapy would consider the setup of my shared room.
examples.zh: 我问「作业治疗」是否会考虑我的合住寝室怎么布置的。

words.enDefinition: a professional helping people participate in everyday activities

examples.en: The occupational therapist asked me to describe a typical day in my residence hall.
examples.zh: 「作业治疗师」请我描述平常在宿舍的一天怎么过。

examples.en: I brought a photo of my doorway to show the occupational therapist.
examples.zh: 我带了一张门口的照片给「作业治疗师」看。

collocations: a home visit by an occupational therapist

words.enDefinition: care for difficulties with communication or swallowing

examples.en: I asked the clinic where the speech and language therapy appointments would take place.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，「言语语言治疗」要去哪里做。

examples.en: The leaflet explained which professionals worked in the speech and language therapy service.
examples.zh: 宣传单介绍了有哪些专业人员在「言语语言治疗」机构工作。

collocations: a referral for speech and language therapy
a speech and language therapy service

words.enDefinition: a clinician trained to assess communication and swallowing difficulties

examples.en: The speech-language pathologist introduced herself before asking me about my usual routines.
examples.zh: 「言语语言治疗师」先自我介绍，然后问了我平时的生活习惯。

examples.en: I asked the speech-language pathologist to send the appointment details in writing.
examples.zh: 我请「言语语言治疗师」把预约信息以文字形式发给我。

collocations: a referral to a speech-language pathologist

words.enDefinition: a worker supporting a rehabilitation team and the people it serves

examples.en: The rehabilitation assistant showed me which room the appointment would be in.
examples.zh: 「康复助理」告诉我预约在哪个房间。

examples.en: I asked the rehabilitation assistant who to contact about updating my address.
examples.zh: 我问「康复助理」，要更新地址应该联系谁。

words.enDefinition: a request for someone to be assessed by a therapy service

examples.en: I asked whether the therapy referral had reached the community rehabilitation team.
examples.zh: 我问那份「治疗转介」有没有送到社区康复团队。

examples.en: The hospital listed the therapy referral among the items in my discharge plan.
examples.zh: 医院把「治疗转介」列在出院后安排的事项里。

collocations: follow up on a therapy referral

words.enDefinition: a document recording an assessment or progress during therapy

examples.en: The therapy report described the tasks I found difficult at home and at university.
examples.zh: 「治疗情况报告」写了哪些事在家和在学校做起来对我有困难。

examples.en: I asked for a second copy of the therapy report for my own records.
examples.zh: 我另外要了一份「治疗情况报告」留档。

collocations: request a copy of the therapy report

words.enDefinition: a meeting or assessment to consider changes since an earlier stage

examples.en: I received the date for my progress review in a letter from the therapist.
examples.zh: 治疗师在信里告诉了我「进展回顾」的日期。

examples.en: During the progress review, I mentioned that my university timetable had changed.
examples.zh: 「进展回顾」时，我提到自己的大学课表变了。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation of what a person can do in ordinary activities

examples.en: The functional assessment included a discussion of the tasks I do at home.
examples.zh: 「功能评估」时，我们谈到了我在家做哪些事。

examples.en: I asked what the functional assessment report would say about using public transport.
examples.zh: 我问「功能评估」报告会怎么描述我乘公共交通的情况。

words.enDefinition: a person's abilities at the point used for later comparisons

examples.en: The therapist asked about my abilities before the illness to establish my baseline function.
examples.zh: 治疗师询问我生病前能做哪些事，以确定我的「基线功能水平」。

examples.en: The report listed baseline function separately from what I could manage that week.
examples.zh: 报告把「基线功能水平」和我那周能完成的事分开记录。

words.enDefinition: the ability to move during everyday tasks and situations

examples.en: The therapist asked how my functional mobility affected getting around the residence hall.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，我的「功能性移动能力」对在宿舍楼里走动有什么影响。

examples.en: I read the section on functional mobility before my meeting with student services.
examples.zh: 和学生服务部门开会前，我读了关于「功能性移动能力」的部分。

words.enDefinition: how far a joint can move in a particular direction

examples.en: The therapist recorded my range of motion in the notes after the assessment.
examples.zh: 评估结束后，治疗师在记录里写下了我的「关节活动范围」。

examples.en: I asked what range of motion meant on the first page of the report.
examples.zh: 我问报告第一页的「关节活动范围」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a review of someone's ability to move safely and independently

examples.en: I asked how long the mobility assessment would take before confirming the appointment.
examples.zh: 确认预约前，我问了「移动能力评估」要花多久。

examples.en: The mobility assessment report described which places I was having difficulty reaching.
examples.zh: 「移动能力评估」报告描述了有哪些地方我很难到达。

words.enDefinition: basic personal tasks such as dressing, bathing, and eating

examples.en: The form asked what help I needed with activities of daily living at home.
examples.zh: 表格问，我在家做「日常生活活动」时需要什么帮助。

examples.en: The therapist explained why activities of daily living had their own section in the report.
examples.zh: 治疗师说明了为什么报告给「日常生活活动」单列了一部分。

collocations: support with activities of daily living
difficulty with activities of daily living

words.enDefinition: the ability to make small controlled movements, especially with the hands

examples.en: The report described fine motor skills in a section about everyday tasks.
examples.zh: 报告在日常活动一节里记录了我的「精细动作能力」。

examples.en: I asked whether using a keyboard was relevant to the notes on fine motor skills.
examples.zh: 我问使用键盘和「精细动作能力」的记录有没有关系。

words.enDefinition: the abilities needed to use the hand in everyday tasks

examples.en: The clinic asked what difficulties with hand function I noticed during lab classes.
examples.zh: 诊所问我上实验课时遇到了哪些「手部功能」方面的困难。

examples.en: I saved the notes on hand function before my appointment with the therapist.
examples.zh: 见治疗师之前，我把有关「手部功能」的记录保存了下来。

words.enDefinition: the force a hand can exert when holding something

examples.en: The therapist recorded grip strength alongside the other results from today's visit.
examples.zh: 治疗师把「握力」和今天就诊的其他结果记在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the grip strength was recorded separately for each hand.
examples.zh: 我问是不是分别记录了两只手的「握力」。

words.enDefinition: how much walking someone can manage before needing to stop

examples.en: I described my walking tolerance in terms of how far I could get across campus.
examples.zh: 我用自己能在校园里走多远来说明「步行耐受度」。

examples.en: The report listed walking tolerance as one of the measures reviewed at each visit.
examples.zh: 报告把「步行耐受度」列为每次就诊都会复查的一项指标。

words.enDefinition: a review of a person's pattern and manner of walking

examples.en: The therapist sent an explanation of the gait assessment before my first visit.
examples.zh: 第一次就诊前，治疗师发来了「步态评估」的说明。

examples.en: I asked the clinician where the results of the gait assessment would be kept.
examples.zh: 我问医务人员，「步态评估」的结果会保存在哪里。

words.enDefinition: an item helping someone carry out a task more independently

examples.en: The therapist explained what counted as an assistive device on the form.
examples.zh: 治疗师解释了表格里哪些东西算「辅助器具」。

examples.en: I asked whether an assistive device could be delivered to my residence hall.
examples.zh: 我问「辅助器具」能不能送到我的宿舍楼。

collocations: an assistive device for everyday tasks

words.enDefinition: equipment helping someone move from one place to another

examples.en: The adviser asked if my mobility aid would fit in the shuttle bus.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「移动辅助器具」能不能放进校车。

examples.en: I listed the mobility aid I use on my updated campus access form.
examples.zh: 我在更新后的校园通行表上填了自己使用的「移动辅助器具」。

collocations: a loan of a mobility aid

words.enDefinition: a review of which equipment fits a person's needs and environment

examples.en: The clinic called to confirm the address for my equipment assessment next week.
examples.zh: 诊所打电话确认我下周做「辅助设备需求评估」的地址。

examples.en: I asked which parts of my home the equipment assessment would cover.
examples.zh: 我问「辅助设备需求评估」会涉及我家哪些地方。

collocations: a report from an equipment assessment

words.enDefinition: an appointment to check that equipment suits its intended user

examples.en: I scheduled the equipment fitting for an afternoon when my tutor was free.
examples.zh: 我把「辅助器具适配」安排在导师有空的一个下午。

examples.en: The therapist confirmed which items were included in the equipment fitting this week.
examples.zh: 治疗师确认了本周「辅助器具适配」包括哪些物品。

words.enDefinition: the process of giving back equipment that was lent

examples.en: I asked which door to use for the equipment return at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问去诊所「归还设备」应该走哪个门。

examples.en: The service sent me a confirmation email after the equipment return was recorded.
examples.zh: 系统记下「设备归还」后，服务机构给我发了一封确认邮件。

words.enDefinition: a handheld stick that gives support while walking

examples.en: I left my walking stick beside the door before taking off my shoes.
examples.zh: 脱鞋前，我把「手杖」放在门边。

examples.en: The theatre asked where I would like to keep my walking stick during the show.
examples.zh: 剧院问我演出期间想把「手杖」放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a walking cane with four short feet for extra support

examples.en: I asked whether the equipment service had a quad cane I could examine.
examples.zh: 我问辅助器具服务处有没有「四脚手杖」可以看一下。

examples.en: The therapist showed me the difference between a quad cane and my old stick.
examples.zh: 治疗师给我看了「四脚手杖」和我的旧手杖有什么区别。

collocations: compare a quad cane with a standard cane
a quad cane with a broad base

words.enDefinition: crutches with cuffs that rest around the forearms

examples.en: The staff asked whether my forearm crutches would fit in the taxi.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我的「前臂拐杖」能不能放进出租车。

examples.en: I checked the label on the forearm crutches before taking them to the desk.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「前臂拐杖」上的标签，再把它们拿到服务台。

words.enDefinition: crutches with padded supports that fit under the arms

examples.en: The receptionist asked when I would bring the underarm crutches back to the clinic.
examples.zh: 前台问我什么时候把「腋拐」还回诊所。

examples.en: I asked whether the padded item on the list meant underarm crutches.
examples.zh: 我问清单上写的带软垫的物品是不是「腋拐」。

words.enDefinition: a freestanding frame providing support as a person walks

examples.en: I needed space in my room to store the walking frame when not in use.
examples.zh: 我需要在房间里腾出地方，收放暂时不用的「助行架」。

examples.en: I asked whether the walking frame in the picture was the model being delivered.
examples.zh: 我问照片里的「助行架」是不是要送来的那个型号。

collocations: a walking frame provided on loan

words.enDefinition: a walking frame with wheels and often hand brakes

examples.en: I asked where I could leave my rollator during the afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我问下午上课时可以把「带轮助行车」放在哪里。

examples.en: The leaflet showed a rollator with a small seat and a storage bag.
examples.zh: 宣传单上有一款带座位和收纳袋的「带轮助行车」。

words.enDefinition: a wheeled mobility aid with a platform supporting one knee

examples.en: I asked the equipment desk whether it could lend me a knee scooter.
examples.zh: 我问辅助设备服务台能不能借给我一辆「膝托代步车」。

examples.en: My roommate measured our hallway to see if a knee scooter would fit.
examples.zh: 室友量了我们家走廊的宽度，看「膝托代步车」能不能通过。

words.enDefinition: a wheelchair moved by hand rather than by a motor

examples.en: The arena asked whether my manual wheelchair would fit in the reserved space.
examples.zh: 会场问我的「手动轮椅」是否能放进预留的位置。

examples.en: I called the equipment service to check when the manual wheelchair would arrive.
examples.zh: 我给辅助器具服务处打了电话，问「手动轮椅」什么时候送到。

words.enDefinition: a wheelchair moved by an electric motor

examples.en: The transport office asked for the overall width of my powered wheelchair.
examples.zh: 交通服务办公室要我提供「电动轮椅」的总宽度。

examples.en: I checked whether the venue could accommodate a powered wheelchair in its seating area.
examples.zh: 我确认了场馆座位区是否能容纳「电动轮椅」。

collocations: a space for a powered wheelchair

words.enDefinition: a cushion designed to fit on the seat of a wheelchair

examples.en: The equipment service delivered the wheelchair cushion in a box with my name.
examples.zh: 辅助设备服务机构把「轮椅坐垫」装在一个写有我名字的盒子里送过来。

examples.en: I asked if the wheelchair cushion was covered by the same loan agreement.
examples.zh: 我问「轮椅坐垫」是不是也包含在同一份借用协议里。

words.enDefinition: a slope providing a route for wheelchairs instead of steps

examples.en: The accessibility map showed the wheelchair ramp behind the student union building.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出了学生会楼后面的「轮椅坡道」。

examples.en: I asked whether the wheelchair ramp would be available during the evening event.
examples.zh: 我问晚间活动期间「轮椅坡道」能不能用。

words.enDefinition: access to a place without having to go up or down steps

examples.en: I emailed the department to ask about step-free access to the laboratory.
examples.zh: 我给系里发邮件，询问去实验室有没有「无台阶通行」的路线。

examples.en: The building map marks the route with step-free access from the library.
examples.zh: 大楼地图标出了从图书馆过去的「无台阶通行」路线。

words.enDefinition: a toilet designed to be usable by people with disabilities

examples.en: I asked reception where to find the accessible toilet near the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我问前台报告厅附近哪里有「无障碍卫生间」。

examples.en: The event map showed an accessible toilet next to the main meeting room.
examples.zh: 活动地图标出主会议室旁边有一间「无障碍卫生间」。

collocations: an accessible toilet on this floor

words.enDefinition: a bar fixed in place to hold for support or balance

examples.en: I asked whether the temporary room had a grab rail beside the shower.
examples.zh: 我问临时房间的淋浴旁有没有「支撑扶手」。

examples.en: The housing officer noted where the grab rail was on the room checklist.
examples.zh: 住宿管理员在房间清单上记下了「支撑扶手」的位置。

collocations: a bathroom with a grab rail

words.enDefinition: a water-resistant seat designed for showering while seated

examples.en: I asked the residence office whether I could borrow a shower chair during term.
examples.zh: 我问宿舍办公室学期内能不能借一把「淋浴椅」。

examples.en: My flatmate made space for the shower chair before the equipment arrived.
examples.zh: 辅助器具送来之前，室友腾出了放「淋浴椅」的地方。

collocations: a bathroom with a shower chair

words.enDefinition: an adapted seat that raises the sitting height of a toilet

examples.en: The checklist listed a raised toilet seat under equipment for the bathroom.
examples.zh: 清单把「增高马桶座」列在卫生间设备那一栏。

examples.en: I asked the equipment team whether the raised toilet seat was included in the delivery.
examples.zh: 我问辅助设备团队，这次配送是否包含「增高马桶座」。

words.enDefinition: a tool with a long handle for picking up distant items

examples.en: The equipment catalogue showed a reacher beside the other items for home use.
examples.zh: 辅助器具目录把「长柄取物器」和其他居家用具放在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the reacher on the list was small enough for my bag.
examples.zh: 我问清单上的「长柄取物器」够不够小，能否放进我包里。

collocations: a reacher with a gripping end

words.enDefinition: a device that helps someone put on a sock

examples.en: I asked what a sock aid was after seeing it on the equipment list.
examples.zh: 我在辅助器具清单上看到「穿袜辅助器」，就问了它是什么。

examples.en: The equipment desk had a packaged sock aid next to the sample dressing tools.
examples.zh: 辅助设备服务台的穿衣工具样品旁边摆着一个包装好的「穿袜辅助器」。

collocations: a demonstration model of a sock aid

words.enDefinition: eating utensils adapted to make them easier to hold or use

examples.en: I asked the therapist where the adaptive cutlery was shown in the catalogue.
examples.zh: 我问治疗师，「辅助餐具」在目录的哪里。

examples.en: The residence kitchen showed me a drawer with several sets of adaptive cutlery.
examples.zh: 宿舍厨房工作人员给我看了一个抽屉，里面放着几套「辅助餐具」。

words.enDefinition: a room designed or adapted for people with access needs

examples.en: I asked for an accessible room close to the student accommodation office.
examples.zh: 我申请了一间靠近学生住宿办公室的「无障碍房间」。

examples.en: The online listing showed photos of the accessible room and its bathroom.
examples.zh: 网上的房源信息展示了「无障碍房间」及其卫生间的照片。

collocations: an accessible room near the lift

words.enDefinition: moving a resident to a different room for a limited period

examples.en: I asked the residence adviser how to request a temporary room transfer after discharge.
examples.zh: 我问宿舍顾问，出院后怎么申请「临时换房」。

examples.en: The housing office offered a temporary room transfer while I was recovering.
examples.zh: 我康复期间，住宿办公室提出可以安排「临时换房」。

words.enDefinition: changes making a home safer or easier for someone to use

examples.en: The occupational therapist asked which home adaptations we could discuss with my landlord.
examples.zh: 作业治疗师问，哪些「居家适应性改造」可以和房东商量。

examples.en: The report listed possible home adaptations beside a photo of our bathroom.
examples.zh: 报告在我家卫生间的照片旁列出了可能的「居家适应性改造」。

words.enDefinition: the raised or flat strip at the bottom of a doorway

examples.en: I sent the housing office a photo of the door threshold at our entrance.
examples.zh: 我给住宿办公室发了一张入口「门槛」的照片。

examples.en: The therapist asked whether the door threshold remained the same after the repair.
examples.zh: 治疗师问，维修后「门槛」是否和原来一样。

collocations: a door threshold at the entrance

words.enDefinition: a movable sloping platform for crossing a step or raised edge

examples.en: The hall office confirmed there was a portable ramp for the side entrance.
examples.zh: 宿舍办公室确认侧门有一块「便携坡道」。

examples.en: I asked who was responsible for bringing the portable ramp to the venue.
examples.zh: 我问由谁负责把「便携坡道」带到场地。

words.enDefinition: a system sending sound directly to compatible hearing devices

examples.en: The lecture hall has a hearing loop that the facilities map identifies.
examples.zh: 报告厅装有「听力感应环路」，设施地图上标了出来。

examples.en: I asked the event organizer whether a hearing loop was available in that room.
examples.zh: 我问活动组织者，那间房能不能用「听力感应环路」。

collocations: a room fitted with a hearing loop

words.enDefinition: transport designed or arranged for people with access needs

examples.en: The student office gave me a number to call about accessible transport.
examples.zh: 学生事务办公室给了我一个咨询「无障碍交通」的号码。

examples.en: I asked whether accessible transport went directly to the rehabilitation facility on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我问星期天的「无障碍交通」是否直达康复机构。

words.enDefinition: raised patterns on a surface providing tactile information to pedestrians

examples.en: The campus map marked the tactile paving outside the entrance to the library.
examples.zh: 校园地图标出了图书馆入口外的「触觉引导地砖」。

examples.en: I asked whether the new path would have tactile paving at the crossing.
examples.zh: 我问新路的过街点是否会铺设「触觉引导地砖」。

words.enDefinition: a staff member advising people on disability-related access and support

examples.en: I booked a meeting with the disability adviser before my first week back.
examples.zh: 返校第一周之前，我约了和「无障碍支持顾问」见面。

examples.en: The disability adviser asked which parts of campus had been hardest to reach.
examples.zh: 「无障碍支持顾问」问，校园里有哪些地方最难到达。

words.enDefinition: a change to study requirements addressing a student's individual needs

examples.en: I asked whether moving my lab section would count as an academic adjustment.
examples.zh: 我问换一个实验课班是否算「学业安排调整」。

examples.en: The adviser put the academic adjustment in writing so I could tell my tutor.
examples.zh: 顾问把「学业安排调整」写了下来，方便我告知导师。

words.enDefinition: a suitable change that removes a barrier for a person with a disability

examples.en: We discussed a reasonable adjustment after the lecture room moved to another building.
examples.zh: 报告厅换到另一栋楼后，我们商量了一项「合理便利安排」。

examples.en: I asked who could approve a reasonable adjustment for the campus placement.
examples.zh: 我问在校内实习期间，谁可以批准「合理便利安排」。

words.enDefinition: a physical or mental limitation expected to last a limited time

examples.en: I asked what campus support was available for someone with a temporary disability.
examples.zh: 我问学校能为有「暂时性功能障碍」的人提供什么支持。

examples.en: The form had a section where I could describe my temporary disability.
examples.zh: 表格上有一栏，我可以描述自己的「暂时性功能障碍」。

words.enDefinition: a classroom arranged so people with access needs can use it

examples.en: The coordinator moved our seminar to an accessible classroom near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 协调员把我们的研讨课换到了主入口附近的「无障碍教室」。

examples.en: I asked where to find the accessible classroom shown on my new timetable.
examples.zh: 我问新课表上写的「无障碍教室」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a revised schedule modified to meet someone's needs or circumstances

examples.en: The department sent me an adjusted timetable before I returned to the residence hall.
examples.zh: 我回宿舍楼之前，系里发来一份「调整后的课表」。

examples.en: I checked the adjusted timetable to see where my lab would be held.
examples.zh: 我查了「调整后的课表」，看看实验课会在哪里上。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement allowing some variation in when or how someone attends

examples.en: I asked about flexible attendance because two appointments fell during the same module.
examples.zh: 我的两次就诊预约都跟同一门课冲突，就问了能不能「弹性出勤」。

examples.en: My tutor explained how flexible attendance would be recorded during my recovery.
examples.zh: 导师说明了我康复期间，「弹性出勤」会怎么记录。

words.enDefinition: taking part in an activity without being physically present

examples.en: The department arranged remote participation for the seminar I could not attend in person.
examples.zh: 系里安排我「远程参与」无法到场的那次研讨课。

examples.en: I asked whether remote participation would also be possible during the group presentation.
examples.zh: 我问小组汇报时能不能也「远程参与」。

words.enDefinition: short periods of rest during a longer activity

examples.en: The invigilator explained how rest breaks would be logged during the exam.
examples.zh: 监考老师解释了考试期间怎么记录「中途休息」。

examples.en: I asked whether the revised lab schedule already included time for rest breaks.
examples.zh: 我问调整后的实验课安排里，是不是已经留了「中途休息」时间。

words.enDefinition: room to change a deadline when someone's circumstances require it

examples.en: I emailed my tutor about deadline flexibility after my return date had changed.
examples.zh: 返校日期变了之后，我给导师发邮件咨询「截止时间弹性」安排。

examples.en: The course coordinator outlined how deadline flexibility would work for the group project.
examples.zh: 课程协调员介绍了小组项目的「截止时间弹性」安排怎么执行。

words.enDefinition: time away from study or work because of a health issue

examples.en: I reported the medical absence through the university portal before contacting my tutor.
examples.zh: 联系导师之前，我先通过学校平台报备了「因病缺勤」。

examples.en: The adviser asked which dates to include in my medical absence record.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「因病缺勤」记录需要包括哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: an approved period away from work or study for health reasons

examples.en: I arranged a meeting with the adviser before submitting my medical leave request.
examples.zh: 提交「病假」申请前，我约了和顾问见面。

examples.en: The university portal showed the expected end date for my medical leave.
examples.zh: 学校平台显示了我的「病假」预计结束日期。

words.enDefinition: a gradual return to regular study over several planned stages

examples.en: The adviser asked which classes to include first in my phased return to study.
examples.zh: 顾问问我开始「分阶段复学」时，想先上哪些课。

examples.en: I shared the dates for my phased return to study with my placement supervisor.
examples.zh: 我把「分阶段复学」的日期告诉了实习主管。

collocations: arrange a phased return to study
discuss a phased return to study
a plan for a phased return to study

words.enDefinition: a gradual return to usual working hours or duties

examples.en: My manager asked how a phased return to work would fit around my lectures.
examples.zh: 经理问，「分阶段返岗」怎么安排才不会和我的课冲突。

examples.en: I put the dates for my phased return to work in the shared calendar.
examples.zh: 我把「分阶段返岗」的日期记进了共享日历。

collocations: arrange a phased return to work
agree on a phased return to work
a plan for a phased return to work

words.enDefinition: well enough to start attending classes again

examples.en: I asked who would assess whether I was fit to resume classes after my leave.
examples.zh: 我问请假之后，会由谁判断我的「身体状况是否允许复课」。

examples.en: My adviser explained who would need confirmation that I was fit to resume classes.
examples.zh: 顾问说了哪些人需要确认我的「身体状况允许复课」。

collocations: confirm someone is fit to resume classes
assess whether someone is fit to resume classes

words.enDefinition: official records or notes supporting a health-related request

examples.en: I asked the registrar what medical documentation was needed for my request.
examples.zh: 我问教务处，这项申请需要什么「医疗证明材料」。

examples.en: The office told me where to upload the medical documentation securely online.
examples.zh: 办公室告诉我，在网上哪里可以安全地上传「医疗证明材料」。

words.enDefinition: restrictions on what someone can do in everyday activities

examples.en: The therapist described my functional limitations without sharing detailed information about my diagnosis.
examples.zh: 治疗师描述了我的「活动能力受限」情况，没有分享诊断细节。

examples.en: I asked how the report on functional limitations would be used by student services.
examples.zh: 我问学生服务部门会如何使用「活动能力受限」的报告。

words.enDefinition: limits placed on which activities someone can do or how

examples.en: I sent my placement supervisor the letter that listed my temporary activity restrictions.
examples.zh: 我把列有临时「活动限制」的信发给了实习主管。

examples.en: The therapist explained where the activity restrictions appeared on the updated report.
examples.zh: 治疗师指出了更新后的报告在哪里列了「活动限制」。

words.enDefinition: assistance with recording important points from classes or meetings

examples.en: I contacted the department to ask about note-taking support for my Monday lecture.
examples.zh: 我联系了系里，咨询星期一的课能否提供「课堂笔记支持」。

examples.en: The adviser confirmed which classes would receive note-taking support during my first week.
examples.zh: 顾问确认了我复课第一周，哪些课会提供「课堂笔记支持」。

words.enDefinition: someone who looks after a person needing help with daily life

examples.en: I asked my caregiver to join the discussion about support after I went home.
examples.zh: 我请「照护者」也参加关于我回家后支持安排的讨论。

examples.en: The form asked whether a caregiver would be available in the evenings.
examples.zh: 表格问晚上是否有「照护者」能提供帮助。

words.enDefinition: someone providing unpaid care outside a professional service, typically a relative or friend

examples.en: The assessor asked if an informal caregiver would be available when I got home.
examples.zh: 评估人员问我，回家后有没有「非正式照护者」能来帮忙。

examples.en: My brother became my informal caregiver for a short time after discharge.
examples.zh: 出院后，我哥哥短暂当过我的「非正式照护者」。

words.enDefinition: a nurse who provides care by visiting someone away from a clinic

examples.en: The visiting nurse called from reception because my building required a visitor pass.
examples.zh: 因为大楼要求有访客通行证，「上门护士」从前台给我打了电话。

examples.en: I asked whether the visiting nurse could contact me on my new number.
examples.zh: 我问「上门护士」能不能用新号码联系我。

collocations: a scheduled visit from a visiting nurse

words.enDefinition: a nurse in a UK community service who visits people at home

examples.en: The ward gave me a number for the district nurse covering my area.
examples.zh: 病区给了我一个服务我所在区域的「片区上门护士」的号码。

examples.en: The district nurse asked if the side entrance was easier to find.
examples.zh: 「片区上门护士」问我，侧门是不是更容易找到。

collocations: a visit from a district nurse

words.enDefinition: a US worker providing basic personal support in someone's home

examples.en: The home health aide confirmed which days she would visit my apartment.
examples.zh: 「居家照护助理」确认了她会在哪几天来我的公寓。

examples.en: I asked the agency whether a home health aide would be available on weekends.
examples.zh: 我问服务机构周末有没有「居家照护助理」能来。

collocations: support from a home health aide

words.enDefinition: health services delivered where a person lives

examples.en: The hospital explained how to contact the agency providing home health care.
examples.zh: 医院说明了怎样联系提供「居家医疗照护」的机构。

examples.en: I asked which services were included in my home health care plan.
examples.zh: 我问我的「居家医疗照护」计划包含哪些服务。

words.enDefinition: support in a person's home with personal and daily tasks

examples.en: The social worker explained the difference between domiciliary care and clinical visits.
examples.zh: 社工解释了「上门生活照护」和医务人员上门看诊的区别。

examples.en: I asked what times the domiciliary care service usually visited our area.
examples.zh: 我问「上门生活照护」服务通常几点到我们这个区域。

words.enDefinition: a timetable showing when support or care will be provided

examples.en: My family shared the care schedule so everyone knew who was coming.
examples.zh: 家人分享了「照护时间表」，这样大家都知道谁会来。

examples.en: I checked the care schedule before agreeing to meet my tutor that afternoon.
examples.zh: 答应当天下午和导师见面之前，我看了一下「照护时间表」。

words.enDefinition: temporary care provided so a regular caregiver can take a break

examples.en: The adviser explained how respite care could cover the weekend my aunt was away.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了，姨妈周末不在时「替代照护」可以怎么安排。

examples.en: We asked which local service offered respite care for a few hours.
examples.zh: 我们问本地哪家机构可以提供几小时的「替代照护」。

collocations: a short period of respite care

words.zhGloss: 独立生活能力恢复服务
words.enDefinition: short-term support helping people manage daily activities more independently
acceptedZhAnswers: 独立生活能力恢复服务

examples.en: The social worker explained reablement while we discussed support after I left hospital.
examples.zh: 我们讨论出院后的支持时，社工介绍了「独立生活能力恢复服务」。

examples.en: I asked how reablement would differ from the regular home help already arranged.
examples.zh: 我问「独立生活能力恢复服务」和已经安排好的日常上门帮助有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a service bringing prepared meals to a person's address

examples.en: The student office sent me information about a meal delivery service near campus.
examples.zh: 学生事务办公室发给我学校附近一家「送餐服务」的信息。

examples.en: I asked whether the meal delivery service could use the residence hall entrance.
examples.zh: 我问「送餐服务」能不能从宿舍楼入口进来。

words.enDefinition: assistance made available to someone through the night

examples.en: The care coordinator asked who could provide overnight support during the first weekend.
examples.zh: 照护协调员问第一个周末谁可以提供「夜间照护支持」。

examples.en: I checked whether the letter included any details about overnight support at home.
examples.zh: 我查看了信里有没有提到居家「夜间照护支持」的安排。
